resources.string: Your phone’s screen and sound on the TV
Pick a TV and press Start
Open “CastLink” on the TV, or type its address below.
TV address (shown by the TV app)
120 frames/s (a little fresher image, more Wi-Fi and battery)
USB cable plugged in. Turn on USB tethering: the PC’s screen on this phone is then much faster and sharper.
Turn on “USB tethering”, then come back
USB cable ready. On the PC pick this phone (its address does not start with 192.168).
Sound is off: the permission to capture audio was not given.
To stop the phone locking while casting, allow “Display over other apps” and come back.

Does the TV show this code?

%1$s

Yes: it matches (the TV will be remembered). No: someone else may be trying to connect.
The TV does not answer. If its CastLink is older, update it (that one does not encrypt).
